intro: This 15 day online yoga therapy course mixes prerecorded videos and daily live Zoom classes (1 hour each) with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn how to use yoga poses, breathing exercises, meditation, and lifestyle changes to improve health and wellness.
During live classes, ask questions, get advice from teachers, and learn how to make these practices part of your daily life.

issues: Unverified marketing stats on page not used: '★★★★★ (340 Ratings)', '4.8 Rating', '4500+ Students', '10+ Yoga Teachers', '10+ Lessons'.
